## Request
Earnings delta for Northbridge Holdings plc, FY2025 against FY2024.

## Findings

### Bottom line
Northbridge grew revenue and EBITDA in FY2025 while leverage stayed near 4.6x, so the earnings trend supports the current credit view.
Basis: NBG_annual_2025.pdf, pages 40–41; calculation C01

Cash generation improved but is still thin after interest and capital spending.
Basis: NBG_annual_2025.pdf, page 55

### Key findings
Revenue rose 4.6% on aftermarket growth, with new equipment sales flat.
Basis: NBG_annual_2025.pdf, page 40

Reported EBITDA rose 4.8%, and the issuer's add-backs widened the adjusted figure by 38.8.
Basis: NBG_annual_2025.pdf, page 41

Cash interest paid was 61.2 in FY2025; the FY2024 figure was not extracted.
Basis: NBG_annual_2025.pdf, page 55
